要求：

  • ComfyUI-BitDance自定义节点存储库

  • BitDance主型号FP8（放置在模型/扩散_模型)

  • BitDance 文本编码器 FP8（放置在模型/文本编码器)

  • BitDance VAE FP16（放置在型号/VAE)

描述：

  • 低显存：利用文本编码节点中内置的“要卸载的模型”设置，此工作流程会在大量文本编码开始之前自动将大量主模型从 GPU 上移出，从而避免硬件崩溃。

  • 速度：通过量化为fp8 e4m3fn 缩放并将主模型路由到显卡，标准消费硬件上的生成时间大大减少。

  • 质量：您保留了近乎完整的视觉保真度。使用所需的欧拉丸山采样器，它可以完美地解码大量的二进制分词器（2^256 状态），以生成完美的微观细节、准确的文本（如阅读报纸）以及从简单的日常英语提示中混合的复杂材料。

链接：视频教程：https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4O9ATPbeQyg

|完整文档：https://aistudynow.com/how-to-fix-the-generic-face-bug-in-bitdance-14b-optimize-speed/

型号：https://huggingface.co/comfyuiblog/BitDance-14B-64x-fp8-comfyui/tree/main

GitHub：https://github.com/aistudynow/Comfyui-bitdance

REQUIREMENTS:

  • ComfyUI-BitDance Custom Node Repository

  • BitDance Main Model FP8 (Place inmodels/diffusion_models)

  • BitDance Text Encoder FP8 (Place inmodels/text_encoders)

  • BitDance VAE FP16 (Place inmodels/vae)

DESCRIPTION:

  • Low VRAM:Utilizing the built-in "model to offload" setting in the Text Encode node, this workflow automatically shifts the massive main model off your GPU right before heavy text encoding begins, saving your hardware from crashing.

  • Speed:By quantizing tofp8 e4m3fn scaledand routing the main model to the graphics card, generation times are drastically reduced on standard consumer hardware.

  • Quality:You retain near-full visual fidelity. Using the requiredeuler_maruyamasampler, it flawlessly decodes the massive Binary Tokenizer (2^256 states) to generate perfect micro-details, accurate text (like reading a newspaper), and complex material blending from simple everyday English prompts.
